faults.detail: Wave 2 asks the child to place "1/6" and "1/8" on the 0-1 line, but its title "Aur chhote" and sub "Zyada parts · tukda chhota" tell the child beforehand that these fractions are smaller than 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 and that a bigger bottom number means a smaller piece. That is the very comparison the piece asks the child to work out, and it is the fact a child who thinks 1/8 > 1/4 has to discover for herself, so the hint gives it away before she can place it wrongly.

notes: The fractions and the 0-1 line are correct, and placing 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/6, 1/8 one at a time on one line does target the 'bigger denominator, bigger fraction' mix-up. The only fault is the wave-2 title and sub that state the answer. p360 was not supplied and is not judged (null). At p412 and l1366 everything is legible and nothing is cut off, though the grey coach line "Fraction ko line par drag karo" is low-contrast on the dark ground. 1/3 and 1/6 fall between the eighth ticks; from the packet I cannot tell how tightly those are graded, so that is not counted.
